Scientific communication and outreach complement research and university teaching. This page is intended to document **public-facing activity** with a clear audience, date and evidence of participation.

## Public lectures and educational activities

Talks for general audiences, public science events and non-specialist educational resources will be added here **when verified**.

## Articles, interviews and media

Public-facing articles, interviews and other contributions will be linked to the original publisher, host institution or event programme.

## Distinguishing outreach from academic service

Research conferences, invited specialist talks and the organisation of scientific meetings are important academic contributions, but **they are not automatically outreach**. They are recorded separately under [Research](research.qmd) and [Academic CV](academic-cv.qmd).
